numbers.label: Share of Anthropic's 2025 revenue that came from two customers
numbers.context: Mia Silverio of Prof G Markets, Oct 5, 2026; 47% of sales ran through Amazon and Google

mentions.excerpt: In late May, Apollo was raising $38 billion of debt to put Google’s TPUs, not Nvidia’s GPUs, behind Anthropic.
In early June, writing about Google’s decision to rent GPUs, he pointed to a revealing price: Google paid roughly double the market rate for Nvidia hardware while its own, cheaper TPUs sat available.

mentions.section: Long the chips, short the returns
mentions.excerpt: If Google is willing to pay roughly double, if Broadcom’s orders exceed shipments by a wide margin, and if customer-wide visibility lasts a year, then scarcity is not a financing mirage.
AWS’s backlog stands at $496 billion, Microsoft’s commercial commitments at $678 billion and Google Cloud’s at $514 billion.

Prof G Markets tallied the immediate bill: Amazon, Google, Microsoft and Meta spent $165 billion on capital spending in three months, up 87 percent from a year earlier and 393 percent from three years earlier.
Google grew cloud 82 percent and search 17 percent, yet its stock fell because capital spending ate the free cash flow.
Deepvalue Capital says Alibaba’s models passed 3bn downloads, ahead of Meta and Google, while compute stays tight and the price per token keeps falling.
Google opened an investor call on its energy strategy with access to power.
Ren points to the income statements: Azure grew 43%, Google Cloud 82% and AWS 37%, its fastest pace in eighteen quarters.
Booking already appears in 61% to 70% of AI travel recommendations, he writes, while transactional searches remain with Google.
Two customers supplied almost 25% of Anthropic’s 2025 revenue, and Amazon and Google channels carried 47% of its sales.

Burry's September 28 list is of a different guarantee: the residual-value guarantees that Nvidia, Oracle and Google Cloud now give on chips, not because they want to, he argues, but because lenders require them for an asset that lost 51% of its value in its first three years.

sides.claim: Citing ERCOT's October 2025 reporting, over 200 gigawatts of large loads have requested interconnection through the interim process, yet less than 4% have been granted approval to energize and about another 7% are eligible to seek energization…

The Joint Commenters recommend the Commission adopt a unifying framework aligning all related rulemakings and ERCOT protocol revisions, advancing cost-causation-based cost assignment that shields residential and small commercial customers from cost…
Shield households by cost causation; $24B of Texas lines need loads that connect.
